summary_en: Tender price revised from ¥3,570 to ¥3,571 per ordinary share; treasury stock acquisition price revised from ¥2,902 to ¥2,903 per warrant. Offer period extended from 2026-08-27 to 2026-09-10 (85 business days total). Minimum purchase commitment 34,941,000 shares. Board endorsement and shareholder recommendation unchanged. No price increase planned by competing bidder BCPE Blitz Cayman, L.P. during offer period.
title_en: Notice of Partial Revision to "Notice of Expression of Opinion Supporting and Recommendation for Tender Offer by Kamgras 1 Inc. for Kakaku.com Shares, etc."
translation_en_brief: On August 28, 2026, Kakaku.com announced a revision to its August 14 disclosure regarding Kamgras 1 Inc.'s public tender offer for the company's ordinary shares and warrants, with the aim of delisting (going private). The offeror raised the tender price for ordinary shares from ¥3,570 to ¥3,571 per share on August 27, 2026, and correspondingly revised the treasury stock acquisition price for warrants from ¥2,902 to ¥2,903 per warrant. The offer period was extended from the original closing date of August 27 to September 10, 2026, increasing the total duration to 85 business days. The minimum purchase commitment remains 34,941,000 shares. Kakaku.com's board of directors confirmed that its endorsement of the offer and recommendation to shareholders and warrant holders remains unchanged. On August 19, 2026, competing bidder Bain Capital (via BCPE Blitz Cayman, L.P., which includes indirect investment by LINE Yahoo Corporation) communicated that it does not plan to raise its offer price during the tender period. The company stated that additional disclosures will follow if material developments occur.
